skill.name: longbridge-watchlist
skill.description: Manage Longbridge watchlist groups, price alerts, and community stock lists through the Longbridge CLI with explicit confirmation for changes.
skill.summary: Manage Longbridge watchlists, alerts, and sharelists with confirmation-gated CLI workflows.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The system-reconnaissance hits are alert workflow language, and the Ruby shell backtick hits are Markdown command examples or fenced documentation, not executable Ruby code. No evidence found of prompt injection, covert exfiltration, or malicious intent.

remediation.issue: The skill runs external Longbridge CLI commands that can change persistent account state.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the preview and explicit confirmation protocol for every create, update, delete, enable, disable, add, remove, rename, or sort action.

remediation.issue: Command examples include user-provided symbols, names, and IDs.
remediation.suggestion: State that agents should avoid shell string interpolation and should pass user values as separate CLI arguments when tooling supports it.

content.value_statement: Investors need a reliable way to organize Longbridge watchlists, alerts, and public stock lists. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code confirmation-gated CLI workflows for those tasks.
actual_capabilities: List Longbridge watchlist groups and resolve group IDs before changes.
Create, rename, delete, add, and remove symbols from watchlist groups after explicit confirmation.
List, add, and delete Longbridge price alerts with direction and price checks.
Browse popular community sharelists and view details for a selected list.
Create and manage community sharelists after a preview and confirmation step.
Surface Longbridge CLI errors and authentication guidance in the user's language.
limitations: Requires the Longbridge CLI or a compatible MCP fallback to be available.
Write operations require Longbridge login and sometimes trade scope authorization.
Does not place trades or provide independent investment advice.
Cannot safely execute unclear mutations without explicit user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Organize Personal Watchlists
use_cases.description: Create groups, rename them, and add or remove symbols while preserving a confirmation step for each change.

use_cases.title: Maintain Price Alerts
use_cases.description: Set or remove alert rules with clear checks for symbol, target price, and rise or fall direction.

use_cases.title: Curate Community Stock Lists
use_cases.description: Browse popular sharelists, inspect constituents, and manage public lists for other Longbridge users.

prompt_templates.title: List Watchlists
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Longbridge watchlist groups and summarize the group names, IDs, and symbol counts.

prompt_templates.title: Add Symbols Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Add NVDA.US and AAPL.US to my Longbridge technology watchlist. Preview the exact change and wait for my confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Price Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Set a Longbridge alert for TSLA.US at 250 USD when the price falls below that level. Ask before executing.

prompt_templates.title: Manage A Sharelist
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Longbridge sharelists, choose the list named Growth Ideas, and prepare to sort its symbols by my preferred order.

output_examples.output: A compact table with group name, group ID, symbol count, and a short note that no account changes were made.

output_examples.input: Add AAPL.US to my dividend watchlist.
output_examples.output: A preview stating the target group and symbol, followed by a confirmation question before any Longbridge update runs.
A ranked list with list name, owner, subscriber count, symbol count, and a prompt to view details for one list.

best_practices: Use the exact Longbridge symbol format requested by the CLI.
Review the preview carefully before confirming any persistent account change.
Ask for IDs, prices, and directions when the user request is incomplete.
anti_patterns: Do not combine preview and execution in one response for write operations.
Do not guess alert direction, target price, group ID, or list ID.
Do not retry a failed mutation silently after an error.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It manages Longbridge watchlists, price alerts, and sharelists. It does not submit buy or sell orders.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: Read operations may work without login. Watchlist changes, alert changes, and sharelist writes require authentication.

faq.question: Why does it ask for confirmation?
faq.answer: The skill changes persistent account state. It previews the exact action and waits for explicit confirmation before running a mutation.

faq.question: Can it use Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the assistant to match the user's input language across Chinese and English.

faq.question: What happens if the Longbridge CLI is missing?
faq.answer: The assistant should tell the user to install longbridge-terminal. A compatible MCP fallback may be used only with the same confirmation rules.

faq.question: Can it manage public community lists?
faq.answer: Yes. It can browse, inspect, create, delete, and manage Longbridge sharelists when the required access is available.
